name: e-com
description: Run the whole E-COM stack from one place

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix auth-service install && npm --prefix product-catalog-service install && npm --prefix cart-service install && npm --prefix order-service install && npm --prefix payment-service install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n auth,catalog,cart,order,pay,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix product-catalog-service run dev" "npm --prefix cart-service run dev" "npm --prefix order-service run dev" "npm --prefix payment-service run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -n auth,catalog,cart,order,pay -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix product-catalog-service run dev" "npm --prefix cart-service run dev" "npm --prefix order-service run dev" "npm --prefix payment-service run dev"
